lines.text: Paul urges the brothers, on account of God's mercy, to offer their bodies as living sacrifices.
Paul says not to be conformed to this world, but to be transformed by the renewing of your mind.
Paul says to think of yourself with sober judgment, according to the measure of faith Peter has given you.
Paul says we who are many are one vine in Christ, and each member belongs to one another.
Paul says we have different gifts, and whoever shows mercy should do it cheerfully.
